notes: A STIB day pass is 8 EUR, and the city centre is walkable. Take the train to Bruges and Ghent (50% off weekend tickets). The train to Zaventem takes 20 minutes.
Summer is 20-25°C, and rain is always possible. Look out for the Ommegang (July) and the August Flower Carpet in even-numbered years. Bruges is very crowded and the Laeken greenhouses are closed.
Waffles cost 3-7 EUR (Brussels = rectangular and light, Liège = dense and sugary), frites 4-6, moules-frites 25, beer 4-6. Tip by rounding up.
In Belgium, French is spoken in Brussels and Flemish in Bruges and Ghent. English is also widely spoken. Avoid the restaurants on Rue des Bouchers (tourist traps), with Chez Léon the exception.
Museums are closed on Mondays. Book Atomium and Belfry online. On the first Wednesday of the month, many museums are free in the afternoon.
Chocolate: Neuhaus, Marcolini, Wittamer, Mary. Leonidas is cheap and good.

stops.name: Grand-Place
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed square with guildhalls and the Town Hall, empty before 10:00. Manneken Pis is 2 streets away. In even-numbered years the Flower Carpet appears in August.

stops.name: Galeries Royales Saint-Hubert
stops.tips: Glass-roofed arcade from 1847. Home to Neuhaus's first shop and Pierre Marcolini.

stops.name: Maison Dandoy Grand-Place
stops.tips: Speculoos and Brussels waffles (rectangular, light) since 1829. Compare with the Liège waffle (dense, sugary).

stops.name: Fritland
stops.tips: A friterie beside the square. Try double-fried chips and a mitraillette sandwich, part of UNESCO-recognised culture.

stops.name: Delirium Café
stops.tips: Guinness record holder with 2,000+ beers. Find it on Impasse de la Fidélité, opposite Jeanneke Pis.

backups.name: Chez Léon
backups.tips: Moules-frites (mussels and chips) since 1893, on Rue des Bouchers.

backups.name: Museum of the City of Brussels Maison du Roi
backups.tips: The city museum in the King's House on the square. Includes Manneken Pis costumes.

stops.name: Magritte Museum
stops.tips: 200+ surrealist works (bowler hat, apple). Combined ticket with the Royal Museums is 15, closed Monday.

stops.name: Place du Grand Sablon
stops.tips: Antique dealers and chocolatiers (Wittamer, Marcolini). Antiques market at weekends.

stops.name: Le Pain Quotidien Sablon
stops.tips: The chain's first branch. Tartines and soup.

stops.name: Place du Jeu de Balle Flea Market
stops.tips: Daily flea market in the Marolles (best in the morning), Brueghel's old neighbourhood.

stops.name: Musical Instruments Museum MIM
stops.tips: Housed in the Art Nouveau Old England building. Instruments with headphones, and a rooftop café with views.

backups.name: Royal Museums of Fine Arts
backups.tips: Bruegel and Rubens. An alternative to MIM (combined ticket with Magritte).

stops.name: Markt Bruges
stops.tips: 1 hour by train (Brussels-Midi, about 15 EUR). Belfry square and guildhalls.

stops.name: Belfry of Bruges
stops.tips: 366 steps to the bell chamber and a panorama of the canal city. Timed tickets.

stops.name: Bruges Canal Boat Tour
stops.tips: 30-minute boat ride. Passes Rozenhoedkaai (the most photographed corner), 5 landing stages.

stops.name: De Halve Maan Brewery
stops.tips: Home of Brugse Zot beer. 45-minute tour plus a beer, rooftop views, good for lunch.

stops.name: Begijnhof Bruges
stops.tips: Beguine courtyard from 1245, peaceful. Minnewater, the Lake of Love, is nearby.

backups.name: Frituur Bruges Markt
backups.tips: Two chip huts beneath the Belfry.

backups.name: Groeningemuseum
backups.tips: Flemish Primitives (van Eyck). Instead of the Begijnhof.

stops.name: Atomium
stops.tips: The 102 m steel crystal from Expo 1958. Spheres and views, book online (combined Design Museum ticket).

stops.name: Mini-Europe
stops.tips: 350 miniatures of Europe at the foot of the Atomium, good with children.

stops.name: Atomium Restaurant
stops.tips: Restaurant with views in the top sphere. Alternatively, use the café outside.

stops.name: Royal Greenhouses of Laeken
stops.tips: Closed (open in spring only). See Laeken Park and the Chinese Pavilion from outside, then move on to Cinquantenaire.

stops.name: Parc du Cinquantenaire
stops.tips: Triumphal arch and museums, in the EU quarter.

backups.name: Frit Flagey
backups.tips: The city's best friterie (Place Flagey). Go by tram.

backups.name: Autoworld Cinquantenaire
backups.tips: 300 classic cars. Instead of the park.

stops.name: Gravensteen
stops.tips: 35 minutes by train. The counts' castle, with a funny audio guide and city views from the ramparts.

stops.name: Graslei & Korenlei
stops.tips: Canal-side guildhalls. The best view in Ghent, from St Michael's Bridge.

stops.name: Saint Bavo's Cathedral Ghent Altarpiece
stops.tips: Van Eyck's Adoration of the Mystic Lamb panels (AR tour). Opposite the Belfry.

stops.name: Patershol
stops.tips: Medieval quarter with restaurants. Try Gentse waterzooi (chicken stew soup).

stops.name: Ghent Canal Boat Tour
stops.tips: 40 minutes, departing from Graslei. Then take the train back.

backups.name: Belfry of Ghent
backups.tips: UNESCO-listed bell tower. Instead of the cathedral.

days.theme: Ixelles, Art Nouveau and the EU

stops.name: Horta Museum
stops.tips: Home of Victor Horta, the inventor of Art Nouveau, in Saint-Gilles. Timed tickets, closed Monday.

stops.name: Avenue Louise Art Nouveau Walk
stops.tips: Hôtel Tassel and Solvay facades in Ixelles.

stops.name: Place Flagey & Ixelles Ponds
stops.tips: Square and lakeside. Market at weekends.

stops.name: Belga Café Flagey
stops.tips: Café on Place Flagey. Croque and beer, opposite Frit Flagey.

stops.name: European Parliament Parlamentarium
stops.tips: Free interactive EU museum. Hemicycle tour with your passport.

backups.name: Moeder Lambic Fontainas
backups.tips: Bar for lambic and gueuze beers. A local alternative to Delirium.

backups.name: Museum of Natural Sciences
backups.tips: Europe's largest dinosaur hall. Instead of the Parlamentarium.

stops.name: Choco-Story Brussels
stops.tips: Chocolate museum with demonstrations, next to the Grand-Place.

stops.name: Pierre Marcolini Grand Sablon
stops.tips: One of Belgium's best chocolatiers. Buy a gift box.

stops.name: Noordzee Mer du Nord
stops.tips: Stand-up fish bar on Sainte-Catherine. Shrimp croquettes and white wine for a farewell.

stops.name: Gare Centrale
stops.tips: Train to Zaventem takes 20 minutes (Midi/Central). Bus to Charleroi takes 1 hour. Farewell.

backups.name: Comics Art Museum
backups.tips: Tintin and the Smurfs in a Horta building. Instead of the chocolate stops.
